BiblicalUsage: Kithlish is a place in Palestine, named once in the town list. Joshua 15:40 names it among the cities of Judah, beside Cabbon and Lahmam.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the town lists are the Bible's way of saying the inheritance was real: every name was a place where people lived, and God counted them all.
